about.title: About
about.intro: HOSANNA GROUP ENGINEERING is a multidisciplinary company specialised in the maritime, building, energy and technology trades.
about.body: We design, build and maintain structures and equipment to a high standard of rigour, safety and quality. Our commitment: to deliver sustainable, innovative solutions tailored to our clients' needs.
about.vision: To be a benchmark player at the convergence of the maritime, technology and building trades, delivering sustainable, secure and high-value solutions.
about.mission: To deliver superior-quality services, compliant with international standards, mobilising multisector expertise to ensure the success and safety of our clients' projects.
about.teamText: A multidisciplinary team of engineers, technicians and experts committed to taking on the most complex challenges.

expertises.intro: Full command of the maritime, industrial, construction, technology and energy trades — to address every project effectively.
